summary.text: A large bulk carrier lost on Harvest Reef near Hood Island, off Esperance, now broken up on the seabed. Its highest parts reach about 13-18 m and it bottoms near 40 m, so it is an advanced boat dive with sharp debris.

summary.text: A guided-missile destroyer deliberately sunk in 2001 in King George Sound near Albany as a dive wreck. It sits upright on its keel, with the upper structure shallow and the seabed near 36 m, and an interpretive trail around it.

summary.text: A former whale chaser scuttled in the early 1980s off Michaelmas Island, King George Sound, as a recreational dive site. The hull has since split in two; the dive is moderate in depth and leafy seadragons live in nearby kelp.
